      "source": [
        "# Task 1: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on Superstore Retail Sales\n",
        "**Internship deliverable | Datheon**\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objective\n",
        "Clean and profile the Superstore sales data, analyze customer purchase volume, monthly seasonality, category-wise revenue, regional/segment performance, and discount sensitivity, then summarize actionable business findings.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Dataset note:** The supplied CSV contains the main transaction table followed by extra lookup/return records. The analysis keeps rows with valid `Order Date` and numeric `Sales`, which isolates the 9,994 transaction records. Missing postal codes are retained as missing because they do not affect the sales calculations."
      ]
    },

        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "from IPython.display import display\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_columns\", 50)\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.float_format\", lambda x: f\"{x:,.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Place superstore_sales.csv in the same folder as this notebook.\n",
        "DATA_PATH = \"superstore_sales.csv\"\n",
        "raw = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n",
        "print(\"Raw file shape:\", raw.shape)\n",
        "display(raw.head())"

              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * @fileoverview Helpers for google.colab Python module.\n",
              " */\n",
              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",
              "  }\n",
              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "
            ]

      "source": [
        "# The CSV includes supplementary records after the transaction table.\n",
        "# Keep transaction rows with a valid order date and numeric sales value.\n",
        "df = raw.copy()\n",
        "df[\"Sales\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"Sales\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df[\"Profit\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"Profit\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df = df[df[\"Order Date\"].notna() & df[\"Sales\"].notna()].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Parse dates and derive useful time fields.\n",
        "df[\"Order Date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Order Date\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df[\"Ship Date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Ship Date\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df = df[df[\"Order Date\"].notna()].copy()\n",
        "df[\"Year\"] = df[\"Order Date\"].dt.year\n",
        "df[\"Month\"] = df[\"Order Date\"].dt.month\n",
        "df[\"YearMonth\"] = df[\"Order Date\"].dt.to_period(\"M\").astype(str)\n",
        "df[\"Order Month Name\"] = df[\"Order Date\"].dt.strftime(\"%b\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Missing values: preserve unknown postal codes, but remove rows missing key analysis fields.\n",
        "missing_profile = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Missing Count\": df.isna().sum(),\n",
        "    \"Missing %\": (df.isna().mean() * 100).round(2)\n",
        "}).sort_values(\"Missing Count\", ascending=False)\n",
        "display(missing_profile[missing_profile[\"Missing Count\"] > 0])\n",
        "print(f\"Clean transaction rows: {len(df):,}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Unique orders: {df['Order ID'].nunique():,}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Unique customers: {df['Customer ID'].nunique():,}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Date range: {df['Order Date'].min().date()} to {df['Order Date'].max().date()}\")"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "customer_summary = (df.groupby([\"Customer ID\", \"Customer Name\"], as_index=False)\n",
        "                    .agg(Orders=(\"Order ID\", \"nunique\"),\n",
        "                         Purchase_Lines=(\"Order ID\", \"size\"),\n",
        "                         Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "                         Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"))\n",
        "                    .sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False))\n",
        "display(customer_summary.head(10))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "plt.hist(customer_summary[\"Sales\"], bins=35)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution of Customer Sales\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Total sales per customer\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of customers\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "monthly = df.groupby(\"YearMonth\", as_index=False).agg(\n",
        "    Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"), Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"), Orders=(\"Order ID\", \"nunique\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "monthly[\"MonthDate\"] = pd.to_datetime(monthly[\"YearMonth\"] + \"-01\")\n",
        "display(monthly.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False).head(10)[[\"YearMonth\", \"Sales\", \"Profit\", \"Orders\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(13, 5))\n",
        "plt.plot(monthly.sort_values(\"MonthDate\")[\"MonthDate\"], monthly.sort_values(\"MonthDate\")[\"Sales\"], marker=\"o\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Monthly Sales Trend\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Order month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Sales\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Compare typical monthly sales by calendar month across years.\n",
        "seasonality = df.groupby(\"Month\").agg(Mean_Monthly_Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\")).reset_index()\n",
        "seasonality[\"Month Name\"] = seasonality[\"Month\"].map({\n",
        "    1:\"Jan\",2:\"Feb\",3:\"Mar\",4:\"Apr\",5:\"May\",6:\"Jun\",\n",
        "    7:\"Jul\",8:\"Aug\",9:\"Sep\",10:\"Oct\",11:\"Nov\",12:\"Dec\"\n",
        "})\n",
        "seasonality = seasonality.sort_values(\"Month\")\n",
        "display(seasonality[[\"Month Name\", \"Mean_Monthly_Sales\"]])\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
        "plt.bar(seasonality[\"Month Name\"], seasonality[\"Mean_Monthly_Sales\"])\n",
        "plt.title(\"Total Sales by Calendar Month (all years combined)\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Calendar month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Sales\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "category = df.groupby(\"Category\", as_index=False).agg(\n",
        "    Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"), Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"), Quantity=(\"Quantity\", \"sum\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "category[\"Profit Margin %\"] = category[\"Profit\"] / category[\"Sales\"] * 100\n",
        "display(category.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
        "plt.bar(category.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False)[\"Category\"], category.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False)[\"Sales\"])\n",
        "plt.title(\"Revenue by Product Category\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Category\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Sales\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "region = df.groupby(\"Region\", as_index=False).agg(Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"), Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"))\n",
        "region[\"Profit Margin %\"] = region[\"Profit\"] / region[\"Sales\"] * 100\n",
        "display(region.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "segment = df.groupby(\"Segment\", as_index=False).agg(\n",
        "    Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"), Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "    Customers=(\"Customer ID\", \"nunique\"), Orders=(\"Order ID\", \"nunique\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "display(segment.sort_values(\"Sales\", ascending=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "pivot = df.pivot_table(index=\"Region\", columns=\"Category\", values=\"Sales\", aggfunc=\"sum\")\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "plt.imshow(pivot.values, aspect=\"auto\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(range(len(pivot.columns)), pivot.columns, rotation=20)\n",
        "plt.yticks(range(len(pivot.index)), pivot.index)\n",
        "for i in range(pivot.shape[0]):\n",
        "    for j in range(pivot.shape[1]):\n",
        "        plt.text(j, i, f\"{pivot.iloc[i, j]:,.0f}\", ha=\"center\", va=\"center\")\n",
        "plt.colorbar(label=\"Sales\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sales by Region and Category\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "discount_analysis = df.groupby(\"Discount\", as_index=False).agg(\n",
        "    Rows=(\"Sales\", \"size\"), Sales=(\"Sales\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "    Profit=(\"Profit\", \"sum\"), Mean_Profit=(\"Profit\", \"mean\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "discount_analysis[\"Profit Margin %\"] = discount_analysis[\"Profit\"] / discount_analysis[\"Sales\"] * 100\n",
        "display(discount_analysis.sort_values(\"Discount\"))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "plt.scatter(df[\"Discount\"], df[\"Profit\"], alpha=0.35)\n",
        "plt.axhline(0, linestyle=\"--\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Discount vs. Profit per Transaction Line\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Discount rate\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Profit\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "discount_values = sorted(df[\"Discount\"].dropna().unique())\n",
        "plt.boxplot([df.loc[df[\"Discount\"] == x, \"Profit\"].dropna() for x in discount_values])\n",
        "plt.xticks(range(1, len(discount_values)+1), [f\"{x:.2f}\" for x in discount_values])\n",
        "plt.axhline(0, linestyle=\"--\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Profit Distribution at Each Discount Level\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Discount rate\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Profit\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]

        "## 7. Executive takeaways (business findings)"
      ]
    },

      "cell_type": "code",

        "execution": {
          "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-20T04:13:15.740554Z",

      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "1. The dataset contains 9,994 valid transaction line items across 5,009 orders and 793 customers.\n",
            "2. Total sales are $2,297,200.86 and total profit is $286,397.02, an overall profit margin of 12.47%.\n",
            "3. Technology is the largest revenue category ($836,154.03); Technology generates the highest category profit ($145,454.95).\n",
            "4. West is the leading region by sales ($725,457.82); West also has the highest regional profit ($108,418.45).\n",
            "5. 2018-11 is the strongest individual month by sales ($118,447.82); use the monthly trend to plan inventory and promotional capacity ahead of peak periods.\n",
            "6. The 50% discount level has the lowest average profit per line ($-310.70); higher discounts should be reviewed against margin and product mix rather than applied uniformly.\n",
            "7. Zero-discount transactions have a combined profit margin of 29.51%; discount decisions should be assessed using incremental sales and profit, not sales volume alone.\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "total_sales = df[\"Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "total_profit = df[\"Profit\"].sum()\n",
        "cat = df.groupby(\"Category\")[[\"Sales\", \"Profit\"]].sum()\n",
        "reg = df.groupby(\"Region\")[[\"Sales\", \"Profit\"]].sum()\n",
        "month_sales = df.groupby(\"YearMonth\")[\"Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "disc_profit = df.groupby(\"Discount\")[\"Profit\"].mean()\n",
        "seg = df.groupby(\"Segment\")[[\"Sales\", \"Profit\"]].sum()\n",
        "top_month = month_sales.idxmax()\n",
        "top_category = cat[\"Sales\"].idxmax()\n",
        "top_profit_category = cat[\"Profit\"].idxmax()\n",
        "top_region_sales = reg[\"Sales\"].idxmax()\n",
        "top_region_profit = reg[\"Profit\"].idxmax()\n",
        "highest_discount_mean_loss = disc_profit.idxmin()\n",
        "zero_discount_margin = df.loc[df[\"Discount\"] == 0, \"Profit\"].sum() / df.loc[df[\"Discount\"] == 0, \"Sales\"].sum() * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "findings = [\n",
        "    f\"1. The dataset contains {len(df):,} valid transaction line items across {df['Order ID'].nunique():,} orders and {df['Customer ID'].nunique():,} customers.\",\n",
        "    f\"2. Total sales are ${total_sales:,.2f} and total profit is ${total_profit:,.2f}, an overall profit margin of {total_profit/total_sales*100:.2f}%.\",\n",
        "    f\"3. {top_category} is the largest revenue category (${cat.loc[top_category, 'Sales']:,.2f}); {top_profit_category} generates the highest category profit (${cat.loc[top_profit_category, 'Profit']:,.2f}).\",\n",
        "    f\"4. {top_region_sales} is the leading region by sales (${reg.loc[top_region_sales, 'Sales']:,.2f}); {top_region_profit} also has the highest regional profit (${reg.loc[top_region_profit, 'Profit']:,.2f}).\",\n",
        "    f\"5. {top_month} is the strongest individual month by sales (${month_sales.loc[top_month]:,.2f}); use the monthly trend to plan inventory and promotional capacity ahead of peak periods.\",\n",
        "    f\"6. The {highest_discount_mean_loss:.0%} discount level has the lowest average profit per line (${disc_profit.loc[highest_discount_mean_loss]:,.2f}); higher discounts should be reviewed against margin and product mix rather than applied uniformly.\",\n",
        "    f\"7. Zero-discount transactions have a combined profit margin of {zero_discount_margin:.2f}%; discount decisions should be assessed using incremental sales and profit, not sales volume alone.\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "for item in findings:\n",
        "    print(item)"
      ]
    },
